definitions.explanation: the legal process of seizing property or assets by court order, typically to satisfy a debt or judgment

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A seizure order was issued by the court.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧になってしまった。
examples.english: Because he had not paid his taxes for years, his house became subject to seizure.

notes:
{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ is a legal term for court-ordered seizure of assets.

COMMON TARGETS OF SEIZURE:
- ⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧ (property)
- ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧ (bank deposits)
- ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧/⟦{給与|きゅうよ}→給与：00264_kyuuyo⟧ (salary)
- ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧ (real estate)
- ⟦{動産|どうさん}→動産：30308_dousan⟧ (movable property)

LEGAL COLLOCATIONS:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧ (seizure order)
- ⟦{仮|かり}→仮：11551_kari⟧{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ (provisional seizure)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧ (release of seizure)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition of seizure)

USAGE:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to have assets seized)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえられる (to be seized)
Used in contexts of debt collection, legal judgments, and tax enforcement.

RELATED WORDS:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえる: to seize, to attach (the verb; ichidan, transitive)
